newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko Sec affiliate says conducted illegal deals.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Sec affiliate says conducted illegal deals.

text.p: Nikko Securities Investment Trust and Management Co, an affiliate of Nikko Securities Co Ltd, said on Wednesday that it had conducted illegal bond trading and expected the Ministry of Finance (MOF) to impose penalties by the end of this week.

An official of the affiliate said the deals, that started at the end of 1994, involved trading foreign bonds at prices higher than their market prices and had been confirmed by an in-house investigation.
Nikko Securities Investment Trust expects the ministry to suspend it from setting up new funds for a certain period of time as a punishment, the official said.
The affiliate is five-percent owned by Nikko Securities, the official said.
The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that if a penalty was imposed, it would be the first time MOF has imposed one on an investment trust firm.
The paper added that the affiliate's president and some senior executives were likely to resign to take responsibility for the deals.
But the company official said no decision had been made on the reported personnel changes.
